title: Joe DeVito
description: "I've always been a big Boba Fett fan," admits Joe DeVito. "Here, realizing he is about to be detected by the unsuspecting X-wing fighter, the ruthless bounty hunter sends it to a fiery death." DeVito has painted and sculpted in many areas of the fantasy and science fiction fields, and specializes in horror and dinosaur subjects. His work has won several awards and has been shown in many exhibits, both in the U.S. and abroad. Recent projects include THE FURTHER ADVENTURES OF BATMAN, SUPERMAN and WONDER WOMAN paperbacks, "Smokin"' Lobo (poster) for DC, a full figure Doc Savage/giant python sculpture as well as cards in THE CREATOR'S UNIVERSE.
